summary: KLA's eBeam Division is looking for passionate software developers to join us and help define and deliver high quality solutions for our current generation and next generation products in our Wafer Inspection and Review product lines.
responsibilities: Build software solutions for our products which would have a direct impact on the semi-conductor manufacturing leading up to a better quality of life for all.
Work with exceptional talent from across multiple global regions and functional groups such as systems/hardware engineering, SMEs, manufacturing, Customer support team.
Develop prototypes and work on solutions for new concepts.
Implement software in accordance with functional use cases ensuring high performance and optimized hardware interactions.
Incorporate sophisticated software algorithms for resource intensive software requirements to optimize and enhance performance of the system.
Coordinate with cross-functional engineering teams—including Software, Applications, Algorithms, Systems, and Customer Support—to resolve critical software issues at customer sites.
required_skills: Knowledge of Object-Oriented software analysis and design
nice_to_have_skills: Understanding of the fundamentals of Computer Science
education_level: Master's or Bachelor's Level Degree in Computer Science or related field
benefits: Competitive, family friendly total rewards package
